current_receipt_timeline: The current derivation receipt was edited after the r2 replay completed to add a pointer to the result and clarify scope. Its pre-execution marker describes the separately preserved pre-execution receipt only; it must not be interpreted as the modification time of the current receipt.
method: The pre-execution receipt bytes were reconstructed from the values used before replay, then SHA-256 checked against the pre-execution digest reported to root before the replay. Matching digest confirms byte identity.
